description: Super contributions (Australia) [AU]. Works out employer super guarantee (12%), total concessional contributions against the 2026-27 cap of $32,500, how much room is left or how much is excess, 15% contributions tax and net into the fund. Flags when Division 293 may apply. Doesn't cover carry-forward amounts, non-concessional contributions or Division 293 tax amounts.

personalDeductible.description: Personal contributions you will claim a deduction for

salary.description: Annual salary (ordinary time earnings) in AUD, before salary sacrifice

salarySacrifice.description: Salary sacrificed into super per year
